name: Grow Anything 🍎
desc:
🍅 Welcome to Grow Anything! 🍕
Mix ingredients together to make unique seeds, and grow one-of-a-kind plants! Make as many combinations as you can, discover all of the recipes and become as rich as you can!

👍 Like the game and join our group

[How to play]
💰 Buy ingredients and mix
🌱 Collect and plant your unique seed
🤑 Collect your fruits and start making profits!
⚒️ Buy gears to make more money faster
🌟 Collect Achievements for free rewards while playing

🌟 Premium Players get a +20% Cash boost!

🕓 Grows & Mixes Anything OFFLINE!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
